title.narrative: WHO'S EMERGENCY RESPONSE TO HEALTH NEEDS UKRAINE AND NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES

description.narrative: Voluntary Funding WHO for its emergency response to health needs in Ukraine and neighbouring countries. Priority actions include the provision of life-saving trauma and emergency health care, including the minimum initial service package (MISP) for sexual and reproductive health care. WHO is also working to strengthen primary health care (PHC) services, and ensure continuity of care, while working to build resilience and response readiness in the event of chemical, biological and radio-nuclear (CBRN) emergencies.As health cluster lead, WHO will continue to lead effective coordination of humanitarian health interventions, information management, surveillance, and early warning systems. In addition it is working to continues its on-going work to enhance health governance and leadership, and support necessary policy reforms.
